|----------------|-----------|------------------------|---------------|----------------------|
| **Narrow (English Practice)** | Monday-Friday excluding English bank holidays | Fewest business days; may delay payments/notices | **High** - tight deadlines | Market standard for English law transactions |
| **Broad** | Any day excluding weekends | More days but includes bank holidays when banks closed | **Medium** - operational issues | Uncommon in finance documents |

   - **5 Business Days prior (Broad):** Count back 5 calendar days excluding weekends: 1 May - 5 days = 26 Apr (Sun) → adjust to 23 Apr (Thu) = **23 Apr 2026**
